sourceFindings: Mac getApp calls computer.get_app_state and bind_mac_app; it does not use create_browser_api to obtain the App handle.
Native binding forwards app-scoped observations, clicks and keys to the native Mac adapter.
Native client uses ComputerUseIPCAppGetSkyshotRequest and ComputerUseIPCAppPerformActionRequest over MacNativePipeTransport.
Native app policy explicitly marks com.google.Chrome with codex/computerUseChrome response metadata.
conclusion: Native Mac control of Chrome works in this session independently of the specialized browser API entry point. Combined with prior independent native-fixture reuse, this supports trying the native provider first; it does not prove independent Chrome reuse or universal background control.
